import random

rng = random.Random(20260926)
pts = set()
for x in rng.sample(range(-19999, 20000), 29998):
    pts.add((x, x * x))
pts.add((-20000, 400000000))
pts.add((20000, 400000000))
while len(pts) < 50000:
    x = rng.randint(-19999, 19999)
    pts.add((x, rng.randint(x * x + 1, 399999999)))
pts = list(pts)
rng.shuffle(pts)
out = [str(len(pts))]
for x, y in pts:
    out.append(f"{x} {y}")
print("\n".join(out))
